## Verified Core Impact Metrics

Every metric below is traceable to production releases and operational logs:

- IDR 1.2 Billion / year: Annual operational cost savings per enterprise client achieved through automated multi-table financial reconciliation at Matchmade.
- 5 -> 1 Day: Monthly financial close cycle reduction, turning multi-day manual matching into a single automated run at Matchmade.
- +60% Payment CTR: Payment click-through rate increase resulting from mobile checkout redesign and progressive form caching at AdaKerja.
- 11 -> 34 GB / month: Transaction volume handled after streaming architecture rework (3x original throughput) at Matchmade.
- -85% Refund Turnaround: Customer service refund processing time reduced from 3 business days to under 4 hours via automated arbitration tooling at PegiPegi.
- -50% Redundant Accounts: Account deduplication algorithm implementation, eliminating 50% messaging waste at PegiPegi.
- -40% Checkout Duration: Checkout completion time reduced across web and mobile apps at PegiPegi.

## Flagship Case Studies

### 1. Matchmade Indonesia (2024 - Present)
- Role: Product Manager (Enterprise B2B SaaS, Financial Reconciliation)
- Problem: Enterprise accounting and operations teams spent 5 business days every month manually matching hundreds of thousands of ledger entries, bank statements, and invoices.
- Product Strategy & Execution:
  - Designed end-to-end automated reconciliation engine with customizable multi-table matching logic.
  - Architected streaming data pipeline handling 34 GB/month with virtualized client-side rendering and deterministic audit trails.
  - Developed AI proof-of-concept utilizing Docling for automated multi-page PDF-to-structured-table extraction.
  - Enforced strict tenant-isolated Row Level Security (RLS) across corporate workspaces.
- Key Outcomes: IDR 1.2B annual client savings; 80% cycle reduction (5 days down to 1 day); 3x pipeline throughput expansion.

### 2. PegiPegi (2022 - 2023)
- Role: Product Manager (Consumer Travel Marketplace / OTA)
- Problem: Two years of payment channel stagnation, customer support overwhelmed with failed transaction escalations, and rising communication costs.
- Product Strategy & Execution:
  - Revamped mobile and web payment checkout funnels and integrated modern payment channels.
  - Implemented asynchronous webhook retry pipeline with idempotent transaction tokens to handle bank gateway timeouts safely.
  - Built automated account deduplication algorithms using phone numbers, payment fingerprints, and device IDs.
  - Transitioned transactional notifications to WhatsApp Business API (75% open rate, 6% communication cost reduction).
- Key Outcomes: 85% reduction in refund turnaround; 50% decrease in redundant accounts; 40% faster checkout duration; +10% new transacting users.

### 3. AdaKerja (2021 - 2022)
- Role: Product Manager (Blue-Collar Job Platform & SME Marketplace)
- Problem: Low conversion in mobile payment funnels and fragmented squad-level backlogs during company restructuring.
- Product Strategy & Execution:
  - Unified product roadmap aligning three engineering squads behind a single North Star metric (verified candidate activations).
  - Designed progressive single-page mobile checkout with client-side form state caching for unstable mobile networks.
- Key Outcomes: +60% payment CTR uplift; unified 3 engineering squads under cohesive architecture.

## Tools Lab & Utilities

A decoupled tools playground hosted at https://athur-exp-bot.tech/tools/ featuring containerized PM utilities:
- LLM Token & Margin Simulator (/tools/llm-token-economics): Models token consumption, margin impacts, and pricing tiers across multi-agent workflows.
- PRD Prompt Compiler & Gherkin Engine (/tools/prd-prompt-compiler): Transforms unstructured requirements into INVEST-compliant Gherkin user stories.
- Multilingual ASR Model Selector (/tools/asr-model-selector): Benchmarks Whisper, Conformer, and regional foundation models for Southeast Asian code-switching speech.
- CalSnap (https://calendar-snap.vercel.app/): AI-powered screenshot and unstructured text calendar parser.
